events.content:
Done! I've created `middleware.ts` that logs every request to the console with:

- Request method, URL, user agent, IP, referer, and timestamp
- Response status code and duration

The middleware automatically applies to all routes in your Next.js app. All requests will now be logged with details like:

```
[Request] {
  "method": "GET",
  "url": "http://localhost:3000/",
  "userAgent": "Mozilla/5.0...",
  "ip": "127.0.0.1",
  "referer": null,
  "timestamp": "2026-02-16T21:50:00.000Z"
}
[Response] GET http://localhost:3000/ - 200 (45ms)
```
